propositions: Multi-phase gate operations (material assembly, overlap corpus retrieval, model calls, tool use) emit no output at default log level between start and final verdict, leaving supervisors with no liveness signal for durations up to 146s across measured phases of 27s, 40s, and 85s

Keepalive lines must be emitted synchronously at LLM-call boundaries (the primary seam in runner.py:296) with elapsed-time coalescing to prevent bursts of rapid tool calls from generating one line per call, targeting a worst-case silent gap bounded to a single model round-trip

Keepalive content must be limited to phase/operation name, call index where available, and elapsed seconds, emitted via logging at WARNING level or above to reach stderr without REBAR_LOG_LEVEL override, with no prompt/response/tool payload content logged

Implementation must be purely additive with no background daemon thread, no progress-gating or stall escalation, no total-runtime cap, and no timeout behavior change, preserving ADR 0089 and keeping silence-tolerance tests green

Gate documentation must include a warning that gate operations routinely exceed common 600s supervisor stall budgets while silent between calls, with guidance on raising supervisor no-output budgets given DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S=600 per-request and close path's multi-request loop
